description:
Are you a fearless thinker? Do you love the challenge of advancing a widely accepted technology? In the Wireless Software group, you’ll be responsible for bringing groundbreaking wireless connectivity to the world through Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, GPS, and more. You’ll design, develop, and patent the next generation of our state-of-the art connectivity technologies. You’ll collaborate across departments to help craft wireless solutions that elevate the customer experience with Apple products and services. Our goal is to ensure nothing stands in the way of our customers’ connections with their devices. If you join us, you’ll help build world-renowned wireless systems so seamless that they almost feel like magic.
Join our Wireless Technologies and Ecosystems organization and drive innovation that matters! We are seeking a talented, highly motivated and hardworking individual to help our iOS Telephony Platform team develop and seamlessly integrate technologies that enrich peoples lives. If you're passionate about the intersection between hardware and software, we may have the job for you.


Description
The Telephony Platform team is looking for a highly motivated iOS Software Engineer to help develop our next generation of iOS and watchOS products. As a member of our team, you will participate in the development of telephony software used a wide range of Apple’s wireless product ecosystem.

Responsibilities
Our team's focus is the intersection between hardware and software. Your daily duties will include designing and implementation of software for our telephony middleware libraries, interacting with cross-functional partners in HW design, verification, factory, operations, among other teams to architect state of the art solutions, and solve technical issues.

Minimum qualifications
Bachelors/Master degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Wireless Communications or equivalent majors


Preferred qualifications
Proven understanding of Object-Oriented Programming. Strong C++ experience preferred.
Proven understanding of operating systems, multi-threaded programming and synchronization.
Excellent debugging skills.
Excellent interpersonal skills.
Ability to thrive in a collaborative environment, and tackle meaningful tasks.
Familiarity with inter-processor communication protocols such as UART/USB/SPI/PCIe is a plus
